color-fg.$description: Primary body text color on light backgrounds.

color-primary.$description: Brand accent color used for primary actions.

color-primary-fg.$description: Text/icon color placed on top of color-primary surfaces.

color-border.$description: Default border color for cards, inputs, and dividers.

color-surface.$description: Slightly raised surface color, e.g. cards on top of the page background.

space-1.$description: Smallest spacing step, used for tight gaps.

space-2.$description: Base spacing step, used for default gaps.

space-3.$description: Medium spacing step, used for component padding.

space-4.$description: Large spacing step, used for section-level spacing.

radius-sm.$description: Corner radius for small controls like chips.

radius-md.$description: Corner radius for standard controls like buttons and inputs.

radius-lg.$description: Corner radius for larger surfaces like cards.

font-size-sm.$description: Small text size, used for captions and chips.

font-family-base.$description: Default typeface stack for all UI text.

border-width-default.$description: Default border thickness for cards, inputs, and dividers.

shadow-card.$description: Soft elevation shadow used under cards.

button-primary-background.$description: Background color for the primary button variant.

button-primary-foreground.$description: Text color for the primary button variant.

button-primary-radius.$description: Corner radius for the primary button variant.

button-primary-padding-block.$description: Vertical padding for the primary button variant.

button-primary-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding for the primary button variant.

button-secondary-background.$description: Background color for the secondary button variant.

button-secondary-foreground.$description: Text color for the secondary button variant.

button-secondary-border.$description: Border color for the secondary button variant.

card-default-background.$description: Background color for the default card variant.

card-default-border.$description: Border color for the default card variant.

card-default-radius.$description: Corner radius for the default card variant.

card-default-padding.$description: Inner padding for the default card variant.
